title: Maximum Candies Allocated to K Children
goal: Give each of k children the largest equal pile size without combining source piles.
strategy: For a proposed portion size, a pile supplies its size divided by the portion rounded down. Feasibility decreases as the portion grows, so binary search the largest size yielding enough portions.
